name: ProjectSpecificRestriction
summary: The card component of Project Specific Restriction (DUO_0000027). It reads ProjectMembershipCredential, IntendedDataUseCredential and AgreementCredential, compares them with its policy data, and outputs the DownloadGrantCredential that Grant download takes.

approvedProjects.description: Project DIDs for which access is allowed; compared with the subject of each IntendedDataUseCredential. If the key is missing, no IDU qualifies and access is denied.
